label: Строится
description: A 10-sentence card for the reflexive -ся passive construction.

missions.phrase: Новый дом строится на нашей улице.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective reflexive passive. This is passive voice built with строить plus -ся, so строится means is being built. Дом is the grammatical subject yet the logical object of the building.
Strategic focus: Plural reflexive passive. Продаются is продавать plus -ся, the imperfective passive meaning are being sold. The books are the subject grammatically but the thing acted upon.
Strategic focus: Reflexive passive with ё. Печётся joins печь and -ся to say is being baked, the imperfective passive. Хлеб stands as subject while remaining the object of the baking.
Strategic focus: Reflexive passive with instrumental agent. Обсуждается is обсуждать plus -ся, is being discussed. The agent комиссией stands in the instrumental, naming who does the discussing.
Strategic focus: Reflexive passive with agent. Читается comes from читать plus -ся and means is read. The agent миллионами людей sits in the instrumental as the readers behind the action.
Strategic focus: Plural reflexive passive. Моются is мыть plus -ся, the imperfective passive are washed. Окна serve as grammatical subject though they are what gets cleaned.
Strategic focus: Reflexive passive. Запоминаются is запоминать plus -ся, meaning are memorized or stick in the mind. Слова are the subject yet the objects being learned.
Strategic focus: Reflexive passive with ё. Продаётся is продавать plus -ся, is sold. Молоко is the grammatical subject although it is the goods being sold by shops.

missions.phrase: Этот мост строится уже два года.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Ongoing reflexive passive. Строится marks the imperfective passive, an action still in progress. Мост is the subject grammatically while remaining the thing being built.

Strategic focus: Paired reflexive passives. Пишутся and отправляются both add -ся to transitive verbs, forming the imperfective passive are written and are sent. Письма are subject yet the objects acted upon.
